structured.rankingRationale: Highest priority is given to confirmed Toronto activity with a clear public-sector or policy demand mechanism and plausible downtown/MTCC/Harbourfront lodging or side-meeting fit. Digital Health Canada ON27, CAPPA and ADSON rank above competitor-committed events because their published venues do not establish a hotel block at a named competing hotel, while FNMPC, PPF, CX, One Future and Urban Transit are retained as constrained future-capture or relationship signals rather than open current inventory.

notesForDeepResearch: Verify whether each organizer has overflow, speaker/VIP, satellite-meeting or future-edition sourcing needs before outreach.
For competitor-hosted events, investigate only evidenced overflow or future rotation; do not present the incumbent venue as available.
Verify public contact names and contracting roles from organizer directories before CRM routing.
materialUncertainties: No candidate source reviewed publishes a room block or peak-room requirement for the target hotel.
Venue confirmation does not establish hotel sourcing openness; several candidates are committed to competing hotels or official accommodation.
The target hotel restaurant/lounge and current catering capability were not verified.
The requested 15–109 peak-room preference cannot be tested without published rooming data.
Toronto-wide or larger events should be treated as overflow, speaker/VIP lodging or side-meeting opportunities only, not exclusive housing.
